script_text: Libra, this week the cosmos is about to flip your world upside down — and you need to be ready. Early week, Venus your ruling planet forms a powerful trine with Jupiter in your 5th House of romance, making Monday through Wednesday electric for love — someone from your past may suddenly reappear with serious intentions. But watch out for Wednesday when Mars squares your 7th House, sparking tension in partnerships. The turning point arrives Thursday as Mercury enters your 10th House of career, unlocking a major professional opportunity — a promotion or financial breakthrough is on the table. By the weekend, the Sun sextiles your 1st House bringing confidence and clarity. Friday is your power day because Venus lights up your 5th House of passion. Tuesday is your worst day due to that harsh Mars square creating conflict. My advice: speak your truth this week, Libra, the air element is on your side. Follow for daily updates.
